title: Presence Thumb — payload
description: A thumbs up sent to a chain-keeping guide, under the visitor's mark (the issuer). Optional: the digest of a claim code the phone keeps, and the room's witness code. The response ($defs.Response) is the appended link.

claimDigest.description: OPTIONAL. Lowercase hex sha256 of the claim code the phone minted and keeps (a vtc/badges ClaimSecret: at least 128 random bits, base64url). Absent means the thumb can never be redeemed for the night's badge.

witness.description: OPTIONAL. The room's witness code as shown on its screen. Absent means a plain thumb, not a witness link.

seq.description: The link's sequence number on the guide's chain.

hash.description: The link's hash, folding the previous link's hash.

kind.description: witness when the room's code checked, else thumb.

expired.description: Present and true when a witness code was given but did not check (its window had passed).
